reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Ampoule 30ml Double Pack
reviews.text: Started using a Cica serum in the evening especially on evenings when I apply actives. This has now become my go to serum. I also like the Parnell serum and alternate between the 2 depending if my skinless or more sensitive. Love the texture of the Round Lab which I find is less viscose than the Parnell so I tend to use it daily in the evening and the Parnell only when my skin more sensitive. I use the Skin 1004 Centella ampoule as part of my morning routine because its very light weight and I prefer that in the mornings.
reviews.zh: 我開始喺晚上用 Cica 精華，特別係用完煥膚成分嘅晚上。佢而家已經成為我嘅首選精華。我都鍾意 Parnell 嘅精華，視乎皮膚係比較少敏感定更加敏感，喺兩者之間交替使用。我會用 Skin 1004 Centella 精華安瓿作為早上程序嘅一部分，因為佢好輕身，我比較鍾意早上用輕盈嘅產品。我鍾意 Round Lab 嘅質地，我覺得佢比 Parnell 冇咁黏稠，所以通常日日晚上都用佢，而 Parnell 就喺皮膚更加敏感嘅時候先用。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Ampoule 30ml Double Pack
reviews.text: I. Love. This. The perfect light ampoule/serum that doesn't break me out and feels very nice on my face. I have oily skin, and while some serums have made it feel worse, this does not so that. Amazing product.
reviews.zh: 我。超。鍾。意。呢款完美嘅輕盈安瓿/精華，唔會令我爆瘡，搽上面嘅感覺好舒服。我係油性肌，有啲精華會令皮膚狀況更差，但呢款唔會。超讚嘅產品。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Ampoule 30ml Double Pack
reviews.text: Este sérum me ha sorprendido, ya que controla bien el acné leve. Lo noté cuando lo dejé de usar por un tiempo y comencé a tener brotes pequeños de acné, lo que me hizo darme cuenta de que este sérum era el que me ayudaba considerablemente. Ahora mismo lo estoy utilizando en mi rutina de día junto con otros productos de la misma marca, y me está yendo genial. Es importante no abusar de este sérum ni combinarlo con rutinas que incluyan retinol o exfoliantes, ya que contiene derivados del ácido salicílico
reviews.zh: 呢款精華令我好驚喜，因為佢對輕微暗瘡控制得好好。我停用咗一陣之後，皮膚就開始生細小暗瘡，所以我就知道呢款精華幫到我好多。我而家日頭嘅護膚程序都會用佢，配合同品牌其他產品，用落效果好正。要注意唔好用得太頻密，亦唔好同含有視黃醇或者去角質產品嘅程序一齊用，因為佢含有水楊酸衍生物。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Ampoule 30ml Double Pack
reviews.text: It doesn't leave anything sticky on my face and absorbs quickly. I've been using this product since last summer in Korea. It was the most helpful thing to cool my face when it was hot. It's a must for summer! I tried other brands' cica products, but some were irritating. Round Lab's cica products are the best for my skin.
reviews.zh: 佢唔會喺塊面留低任何黏笠嘅感覺，好快就吸收。我由去年暑假喺韓國開始用呢款產品。當時天氣熱，佢係幫我塊面降溫最有用嘅嘢。夏天必備！我試過其他品牌嘅 cica 產品，有啲會刺激皮膚。Round Lab 嘅 cica 產品對我嘅皮膚嚟講係最好嘅。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB PINE CALMING CICA AMPOULE 30ml Set (+Cream 10mL)
reviews.text: exactly 12 days have passed since using this tool and the result is immediately noticeable! I would give this product 1000/10. In the first photo, you can see the products I used during these 12 days, I wiped my face with paper towels. I am 1000% satisfied
reviews.zh: 用咗呢款產品啱啱 12 日，效果即刻見到！我會俾呢款產品 1000/10 分。第一張相你可以見到呢 12 日我用嘅產品，我用紙巾抹面。我 1000% 滿意。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB PINE CALMING CICA AMPOULE 30ml Set (+Cream 10mL)
reviews.text: Great for sensitive skin and hot-weather climates. I was initially worried because my skin is super sensitive and was not familiar with pine-based products, but was so happy I bought this after trying the first time! Ampoule has slight scent (like a light powder scent) but disappears quickly; the texture is not sticky, slightly cooling, and absorbs quickly. The cream is unscented, gel texture, and absorbs quickly while giving lots of moisture. I live in a tropical climate, but after using the ampoule and cream I noticed my face did not get as flushed and hot as usual, and a little less oily (but not dried out). Really love this line now.
reviews.zh: 好啱敏感肌同熱天氣氣候。本來有啲擔心，因為我皮膚超敏感，又未試過松木成分嘅產品，但試咗第一次就好慶幸買咗！安瓿有少少香味（好似輕盈嘅粉末味），不過好快就散；質地唔黏笠，有少少涼感，好快吸收。面霜就無味，gel 狀質地，吸收得快又俾到好多保濕。我住喺熱帶氣候，但用完安瓿同面霜之後，塊面無以前咁容易泛紅發熱，出油都少咗少（但又唔會乾）。而家真係好鍾意呢條線。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Ampoule 30ml Double Pack
reviews.text: I got to use it in a smaller size (10 ml) which was included in the dokdo toner box I bought a couple of months ago. I loved it so much that I got this double set this time. It calms down my blemishes over night. It is a good cica serum!
reviews.zh: 我幾個月前買咗 dokdo 爽膚水，入面有附贈細支裝（10ml）俾我試用。用完覺得好正，所以今次直接買咗雙支裝。佢過夜幫我退痘痘。係一款好嘅 cica 精華！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB PINE CALMING CICA AMPOULE 30ml Set (+Cream 10mL)
reviews.text: I do have oily-but-dry face. every now and then I do break out so I purchased it for soothing my skin. I did not see any difference using this.
reviews.zh: 我係油性但偏乾嘅膚質。間唔中會爆瘡，所以買咗佢想舒緩皮膚。用完之後完全睇唔到有任何分別。
